subtitle: What you're asking for, and what actually happened

steps.label: GET
steps.sub: read a resource — never changes anything

code:
DELETE /orders/1001   (1st call) -> order gone
DELETE /orders/1001   (2nd call) -> still gone
  same end state = idempotent

POST /orders   (1st call) -> order A created
POST /orders   (2nd call) -> order B created
  different end state = NOT idempotent
caption: Calling it once vs. five times should end the same way — or not.

steps.label: 4xx
steps.sub: client error — you did something wrong

steps.label: 5xx
steps.sub: server error — it failed on a valid request

code:
200 OK                    - success, here's your data
201 Created               - success, new resource exists
204 No Content            - success, nothing to send back
400 Bad Request           - your request was malformed
401 Unauthorized          - missing/invalid credentials
404 Not Found             - that resource doesn't exist
429 Too Many Requests     - you're being rate-limited
500 Internal Server Error - the server failed
caption: 429 and the 5xx codes come back in Chapter 3's retry lesson.
